workstreams.name: Full-corpus run (code v9 / v9a / v9p)
workstreams.note: fleet of ~40 boxes across 3 regions works through all 12,467 IFC-sourced models; every model gets its build scripts and full verification (per part, per assembly / mark, whole model, end-to-end script run, byte-identical rebuild)

workstreams.name: Speed-up (v9p)
workstreams.note: live since 18:45 PDT (2.9-4.5x faster, byte-identical on 43 models up to 491 MB). Review found memory / fault-handling risks on the >=1 GB tail (no wrong results): fleet memory accounting fixed (PSS); hardening for v10 being proven on real >=1 GB models

workstreams.name: Fix: empty GlobalId (Tekla project-origin marker)
workstreams.note: part id falls back the same way the delivered STEP does

workstreams.name: Fix: crashes (authoring-fact check, zipped IFC with .ifc name)
Rerun: crash-only models (177)
workstreams.note: models whose only failure was the authoring-fact-check crash fixed in v9a (every part already matching) - rerun on current code

workstreams.name: Fix: end-to-end script failures
workstreams.note: multi-solid parts were written in model coordinates (precision loss); the fix is right but changes 7 already-perfect models' schedules, which must be disclosed and re-baselined first

workstreams.name: Fix: SDS/2 delivered-part matching
workstreams.note: largest SDS/2 cluster (~30% of SDS/2 models)

workstreams.name: Fix: Tekla cut / notch mismatches
workstreams.note: round 1 fixed 4 causes (fuzzy booleans keeping cut material, self-crossing outlines, volume integration, evidence-based reference defects): on 79 affected models perfect 0 -> 17, mismatching parts 415 -> 281, invalid solids 106 -> 14, 0 regressions. Round 2: the remaining sub-causes + ~30 tube fish-mouth parts that falsely matched (kernel and rebuild wrong the same way)

workstreams.name: Fix: exact-face geometry
workstreams.note: 14 sub-causes found and fixed (SDS/2 hole winding, T-profiles, faces slightly off-plane, openings on faceted parts, ...)

workstreams.name: Fix: exact-face geometry (scale track)
workstreams.note: sub-clusters the exact-face failures across all ~1,700 affected models (largest bucket of the gap), then fixes each sub-cause; builds on round 2

workstreams.name: Fix: recovered-part mismatches
workstreams.note: 676 affected models sub-clustered (13,438 mismatching recovered parts + matching issues); fixing. 7% of failing parts in 10-100 MB models, 22% in 100-500 MB

workstreams.name: Exact B-rep distance gate
workstreams.note: two-sided surface distance <= 0.1 mm per part vs the IFC source B-rep

workstreams.name: Marks from property sets
workstreams.note: Tekla writes the part mark into Pset_*Common.Reference (v9a missed it on most secondary parts); SDS/2 piecemarks too. Review asked for a fail-closed evidence gate before adopting Reference marks

workstreams.name: PII redaction of published outputs
workstreams.note: 8 of 10 review findings fixed; last 2 being closed before anything is published. Individuals' names / logins / emails / phones removed, organisations kept

workstreams.name: DB1 / SDS2 models (271)
workstreams.note: SDS/2 (97): IFC emitted for all 97 by our converter, 76 run so far, 69 perfect (review running). DB1 (174): IFC regeneration running. Source check here = consistency check, stated as such

workstreams.name: Publishing
workstreams.note: owner decision: same layout as the 5 published samples, inside each perfect-tier package: scripts/, verification/, metadata.json, a README and a manifest of the added files; the package's own files are untouched. Publishing starts with v10 and only after the PII gate passes review

workstreams.name: v10 = all fixes + speed-up, then full rerun
workstreams.note: merge of every fix that passes review, regression-gated (perfect models stay perfect, any change disclosed); then every model is rerun on v10 so all published scripts come from one verified version
